seo.title: Features — Qarote RabbitMQ Monitoring
seo.description: Agent-native RabbitMQ monitoring: MCP tools, deterministic incident detection, AI root-cause, config scan, topology, alerting, and self-hosting.

head.title: Everything your agent needs to debug RabbitMQ.
head.lead: Qarote detects incidents, explains root cause, and exposes all of it to your AI coding agent over MCP. Here's the whole product — starting with the part nothing else has.

agentNative.title: An MCP surface your agent already speaks.
agentNative.body: Most RabbitMQ tooling stops at metrics. Qarote ships a deterministic incident engine and managed root-cause analysis behind one MCP surface — so you debug by asking, in the editor you're already in.

incident.title: A deterministic rules engine, not a guess.
incident.body: Live, rules-based detection fires the moment broker state crosses a threshold — dropped consumers, depth anomalies, stalled acks. No baseline period, no dashboards to build. Open source, MIT.

aiExplain.title: Root cause, written for you on demand.
aiExplain.bodyPost: call turns an incident plus the surrounding broker state into a plain-language root cause. Bring your own key, run it managed, or keep it fully local on Ollama. Plan-gated — never deploy-gated.
aiExplain.cardBody: The 3 consumers disconnected at 15:06; depth climbs ~8k/min with zero drain — likely a crashed worker downstream. Check deploys around 15:05.

configScan.title: Catch the anti-patterns before they page you.
configScan.body: A structural scan flags the RabbitMQ mistakes that become 3 a.m. incidents — missing dead-letter exchanges, idle no-consumer queues, default-exchange overuse — each one something your agent can read back to you.

finds.text: Rejected messages are dropped silently across 5 queues.
emails.outbound has had zero consumers for 9 days.
82% of publishes route through the default exchange.

topology.title: The live broker map, with drill-down.
topology.body: See exchanges, queues, and bindings as a graph. Click any node to inspect depth, consumers, and bindings — the old object-list "Browse" dissolved into a map you can actually reason about. Charts keep 30 days of metric history.
topology.caption: live topology · click a node to drill in

alerting.title: Route what matters, where it matters.
alerting.body: Findings reach you by email, Slack, or webhook, with per-severity routing so criticals page and the rest digest. Email is free; Slack and webhooks unlock on Developer.

connect.title: Two minutes to your first finding.
connect.body: Connect over the Management HTTP API on TLS — no exporter, no agent on the box. One broker or many; RabbitMQ 3.x & 4.x; single-node or clustered; CloudAMQP and Amazon MQ included.
connect.codeComment: point Qarote at the Management API

deploy.title: Your network, your model, your rules.
deploy.body: Run Qarote cloud-hosted, or self-host with Docker, Compose, Dokku, or a standalone binary. Self-hosted validates its license offline — no phone-home — and AI Explain can run on local Ollama, so broker data never leaves your network.
deploy.cardBody: Detection core is MIT and open source. Self-hosted license validation is offline. Local Ollama keeps every byte of broker state inside your perimeter.

cta.heading: See it on your own broker.
cta.body: Connect in under two minutes, then ask your agent what's wrong.
